candidates.explanation: After the forgot-password hash is verified, resetPassword sets the new password and updates the user. It never deletes the user's existing sessions. A device that was already signed in therefore keeps a valid session, and its refresh token still works in AuthService.refreshToken, so it can renew its login. The code should call this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) after the password update.

fix.description: In resetPassword, after `await this.usersService.update(user.id, user);`, add `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });` so every session is revoked and no refresh token can be used again.
